feeds.title: Econo Envelope Blog
feeds.description: EconoEnvelope is your source for high-quality, inexpensive printed envelopes. We are proud to sell more printed envelopes over the internet than any other company in the market at low prices with no hidden surprises. Our mission is to consistently provide the best possible service, support, and quality on each and every print job. We excel at fast turnaround without sacrificing quality.

feeds.title: Pushing The Envelopes Blog
feeds.description: I am Jean Wilson and my mail art/envelope blog Pushing The Envelopes began on Feb 17, 2010, as a vehicle to stay in touch with students. There is a new envelope every single day and there are other blogs to cover other topics like decorated envelopes, mail art, lettering ideas, and many more.

feeds.title: The All Colour Envelopes Blog
feeds.description: All Colour Envelopes is a family-run business and the team enjoys over six decades of combined industry experience Whether you are looking to buy for marketing campaigns, direct mail, company stationery, or greeting cards, our extensive range provides the high quality that you are looking for. You can choose from 12 lines. From earth-rich tones of the Intensive line to ultra-bright hues of the Vibrant line you will be amazed at the choice of texture and color.

feeds.title: Kwernerdesign Blog » Envelopes
feeds.description: K Werner Design Blog was created by Kristina Werner in August 2006. It is home to weekly card videos and the Holiday Card Series. Part paper crafting, part of everyday life, is both a creative outlet and a way to share with others. From the envelopes section of the website get to know everything about envelopes - where to buy and how to make learn some tips and advice.

feeds.title: Allied Envelope
feeds.description: With more than three million envelopes in stock and a knowledgeable and experienced staff, Allied Envelope is committed to meeting all your business communication needs- well beyond envelopes! We also can provide the expertise to make sure your business is utilizing its resources to the fullest by taking advantage of inventory, postage, and fulfillment programs.

feeds.title: Parkland Direct Blog
feeds.description: Parkland Direct is an established, high-quality litho print and envelope manufacturer with extensive experience in foiling, embossing, and specialty coatings. Since starting in 1978, we have always been committed to providing quality and timely service at competitive prices. Our dedication to craftsmanship and processes is supported by continuous investments in people and manufacturing.
